title: fea.plan
summary: Plan a RunMat FEA study or sweep without solving.
description: `fea.plan(study)` validates and plans a `.fea` path, `fea.Study`, or `fea.Sweep` without executing the solver.
behaviors: The input is a text path or typed study/sweep object; integer arrays have no input role.
Planning resolves model data, runs validation, selects the versioned operation sequence, and writes planning evidence before returning.
Plan counts, indexes, revisions, and other discrete metadata are structural integer outputs and remain exact; estimated physical or timing quantities retain their declared floating representation.

Planning does not intrinsically require native OCCT when supplied geometry is already loaded or uses a non-OCCT import path. A topology-bearing CAD source may require its configured geometry importer during document resolution.

faqs.question: Does planning run the solver?
faqs.answer: No. It validates and records the selected operation sequence without solving.
